sources.title: CloudEvents Specification 1.0.2
lockedClaims: A producer must make source plus id unique for each distinct event.
A resent duplicate may keep the same id and a consumer may treat identical source and id as duplicates.
The optional time attribute describes when the occurrence happened, subject to a source-consistent fallback when that time is unavailable.

sources.title: OGC SensorThings API Part 1: Sensing Version 1.1
lockedClaims: phenomenonTime is the instant or period when an Observation happens.
resultTime is the time when the Observation result was generated.
The two fields are separate and may therefore support distinct occurrence and result-generation chronology.

independenceNote: CloudEvents identity semantics and OGC observation-time semantics are distinct official documentation roots. The Node.js fixture is a reproducible KAOPU derivation, not an independent physical or transport observation.
